revised_teaching_units.scope: Follow a versioned release manifest through native Git SSH signature validation, exact file hashing and independent activation readback.
revised_teaching_units.observation: A trusted old signature remains valid when a local alias moves, but the changed bytes fail the manifest digest. A separately valid but untrusted signing key also fails, and active bytes remain v1.

revised_teaching_units.scope: Separate two native DataLoader worker preparation records from the trainer checkpoint and compare resumed SGD with uninterrupted execution.
revised_teaching_units.observation: Workers prepare batches 0 through 4 while the trainer commits only batch 0. A new trainer resumes at batch 1 with the same updates. Cursor 5 skips four uncommitted batches.

revised_teaching_units.scope: Trace a withdrawn preference through the live LangGraph Store, an older task checkpoint, resumption and an independent HTTP receiver.
revised_teaching_units.observation: The old task sends the short format when it reuses state, and the standard format after a current read. Deleting old task checkpoints does not change the two already captured receipts.
